title: Senior UX Designer - Wholesale Banking @ING Hubs RO
full_description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help ofover2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies.Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities andoperatefrom two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilitiesremainthe core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Dataand AnalyticsTech,Tech Foundation andChannels,Retail Core Banking and Architecture, andGlobal Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impactisn'taperk.It'sthe driver of our work.We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactfulthingsand they love doing it in good company. Do you?
You will be part of the Center of Expertise UX Design and Content. Our mission is to execute the seamless digital delivery strategy with a positive result. We are a team with passionate UX design specialists and content writers. OurCoEworks with different tribes,squadsand stakeholders throughout ING Wholesale Bank. We work according to the ING agile way of working.
OurCoEis currently based inAmsterdamandwe are expanding our team with UX designers in our ING Hubs Romania location.This role will be the first UX designer in this setting, so you will also play an important role in building the team in Romania.
You will design,testand improve our inhouse builtapplications and help digitize our many processes. We design for our ingwb.com website,InsideBusinessPortal (our web banking platform),InsideBusinessServices (our employee facing service platform), a mobile app and a lot of other specialized applications throughout the bank. Our users areclientsand internal users who are spread over more than 35 countries who use our channels for daily banking, service, finding information and to buy our products.
Together with Customer Journey Experts and Engineers we are here to deliver on our customer promise. You work in a tech-driven environment in multidisciplinary teams indifferent partsof the bank to provide customers a superior banking experience that is also positive for the planet.
You willmaintaina helicopter-view of what is needed to deliver the bestdesignsand you will be able to prioritize your tasks accordingly to get the most value for our customers.
